name: Asayoru Shozo
source:
"Sheesh... that's boring."

World record holder for speed cubing. In recognition of his outstanding ability, he was admitted to Hope's Peak Academy. He shows an indifferent attitude with no interest in anything other than Cube, but his basic brain is excellent, and his insight and instant judgment are far superior. He hates the company of others and shows a bit of a sociopathic temperament.
